tidbit: Did you know… about 13,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Samsung hosts an artificial intelligence seminar with OpenAI, training 2,300 executives toward full adoption by 2027. Reported by The Korea Daily.
GitHub launches artificial intelligence agent tools at Universe 2026, with India's developer base at 32M. Reported by ET Enterprise AI.
OpenAI cuts funding to $20B at $1.25T amid rising computing costs and competitor pressure. Reported by NAI500.
Infisical raises $40M to let Airbus and Volkswagen use agents securely without sharing credentials. Reported by Forbes Middle East.
A malicious Claude Code-branded extension briefly served on Cursor marketplace to exploit users with a persistent SSH backdoor. Reported by Microsoft.
Free every hour.
